mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.tenant_id, p.enrollment_id, p.lesson_id, l.title AS lesson_title, p.watched_sec, p.completed, p.last_watched_at FROM progress p JOIN lesson l ON p.lesson_id = l.id WHERE p.enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} ORDER BY l.sort_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO progress (tenant_id, enrollment_id, lesson_id, watched_sec, completed, last_watched_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{enrollmentId}, #{lessonId}, #{watchedSec}, #{completed}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, enrollment_id, lesson_id) DO UPDATE SET watched_sec = GREATEST(progress.watched_sec, EXCLUDED.watched_sec), completed = EXCLUDED.completed OR progress.completed, last_watched_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT ps.id, ps.tenant_id, ps.enrollment_id, u.name AS student_name, c.title AS course_title, ps.total_lessons, ps.completed_lessons, ps.completion_rate, ps.last_updated_at FROM progress_summary ps JOIN enrollment e ON ps.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN users u ON e.user_id = u.id JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id WHERE ps.enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId}

SELECT ps.id, ps.tenant_id, ps.enrollment_id, u.name AS student_name, c.title AS course_title, ps.total_lessons, ps.completed_lessons, ps.completion_rate, ps.last_updated_at FROM progress_summary ps JOIN enrollment e ON ps.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN users u ON e.user_id = u.id JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id WHERE e.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY ps.completion_rate DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO progress_summary (tenant_id, enrollment_id, total_lessons, completed_lessons, completion_rate, last_updated_at) SELECT e.tenant_id, e.id AS enrollment_id, COUNT(l.id) AS total_lessons, COUNT(p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.completed = TRUE) AS completed_lessons, ROUND( COUNT(p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.completed = TRUE)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(l.id), 0) * 100, 2 ) AS completion_rate, NOW() FROM enrollment e JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id JOIN lesson l ON l.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN progress p ON p.enrollment_id = e.id AND p.lesson_id = l.id WHERE e.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY e.tenant_id, e.id ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, enrollment_id) DO UPDATE SET total_lessons = EXCLUDED.total_lessons, completed_lessons = EXCLUDED.completed_lessons, completion_rate = EXCLUDED.completion_rate, last_updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO progress_summary (tenant_id, enrollment_id, total_lessons, completed_lessons, completion_rate, last_updated_at) SELECT e.tenant_id, e.id, COUNT(l.id), COUNT(p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.completed = TRUE), ROUND( COUNT(p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.completed = TRUE)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(l.id), 0) * 100, 2 ), NOW() FROM enrollment e JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id JOIN lesson l ON l.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN progress p ON p.enrollment_id = e.id AND p.lesson_id = l.id WHERE e.status = 'ACTIVE' AND e.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT enrollment_id FROM progress WHERE last_watched_at >= #{since} ) GROUP BY e.tenant_id, e.id ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, enrollment_id) DO UPDATE SET total_lessons = EXCLUDED.total_lessons, completed_lessons = EXCLUDED.completed_lessons, completion_rate = EXCLUDED.completion_rate, last_updated_at = NOW()
